mapper.sql: id, source_run_id, report_id, plan_type, title, target_factory, target_area, risk_basis, draft_content_json, status, draft_idempotency_key, config_version, lock_version, draft_by, approver, approver_name, approved_at, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cps_inspection_plan WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_inspection_plan SET draft_content_json = #{draftContentJson}, config_version = IFNULL(#{configVersion}, 0) + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'

UPDATE cps_inspection_plan SET status = 'APPROVED', approver = #{approver}, approver_name = #{approverName}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, lock_version = IFNULL(#{lockVersion}, 0) + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND lock_version = IFNULL(#{lockVersion}, 0)

UPDATE cps_inspection_plan SET status = 'REJECTED', approver = #{approver}, approver_name = #{approverName}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, lock_version = IFNULL(#{lockVersion}, 0) + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND lock_version = IFNULL(#{lockVersion}, 0)
